html:
Connecting LLMs, CRMs, Slack channels, and SQL databases used to be simple linear triggers: "When a form submits, create a HubSpot contact." In 2026, AI agent workflows branch, loop over arrays, sanitize JSON, poll APIs, and execute multi-step tool calls—turning innocuous-looking automations into 15- to 40-step runs per event. Under per-task cloud billing, costs explode fast.

This benchmark compares n8n, Make (formerly Integromat), and Zapier across real execution math, self-hosted privacy control, and team maintainability. (See also our earlier comparison: Zapier vs Make Core Workflow Costs.)

The Critical Billing Difference: Steps vs. Operations vs. Full Executions

1. Why AI Workflows Favor n8n Architecture

When an AI workflow reads a 50-row spreadsheet, summarizes each row, validates formatting, and retries failures:

  • Zapier & Make multiply costs by every loop iteration and branch filter.
  • n8n charges only 1 workflow execution even if that workflow loops across 200 items, parses code in JavaScript/Python nodes, and invokes native AI Agent chains with memory buffers.

For engineering teams or technical ops leads, n8n also allows dropping inline JavaScript transformations cleanly, while pairing seamlessly with low-cost open-weight endpoints covered in our DeepSeek vs OpenAI small business analysis.

2. Privacy, GDPR & Client Data Sovereignty

If your automation processes HIPAA patient intakes, European GDPR payroll files, or confidential customer legal PDFs:

  • Zapier & Make route every JSON payload through vendor cloud infrastructure (requires Enterprise tiers for strict custom data retention policies or EU region pinning).
  • Self-hosted n8n runs inside your own AWS VPC, Hetzner EU instance, or Azure cluster. Sensitive payloads travel strictly between your private server and your chosen compliant AI endpoint—mirroring the zero-upload philosophy used on ToolValueLab Images.

3. When Non-Technical Teams Should Still Pick Zapier or Make

Developer maintenance has a real hourly cost. Self-hosting n8n means handling Docker updates, webhook SSL certificates, Postgres queue backups, and credential encryption keys. Choose Zapier if your marketing coordinator needs 7,000 turnkey app connectors in 10 minutes with zero DevOps support, and choose Make if you want visual data routing at mid-tier cloud pricing without managing Linux servers.

4. TCO Modeling at 100k, 500k, and 2M Monthly AI Steps

Billing architecture compounds rapidly once agents run scheduled polling, RAG chunk loops, or enrichment retries. Suppose a single CRM lead triggers webhook intake, 12-item array deduplication, two LLM classification passes, Slack notification, and Postgres upsert (roughly 18 discrete actions per lead across 25,000 leads per month = 450,000 steps).

5. Production Reliability: Dead-Letter Queues, Webhooks & EU GDPR Residency

For agencies handling healthcare, fintech, or EU personal data under GDPR, self-hosting n8n inside a private VPC (Frankfurt eu-central-1 or US us-east-1) keeps customer JSON payloads off multi-tenant SaaS automation brokers. Add a dedicated Error Workflow connected to Slack/PagerDuty, enable Postgres execution pruning every 14 days so disk IOPS stays predictable, and keep webhook payloads slim—for instance, compressing user-uploaded images via browser-side compression before ingesting media URLs into backend flows. For engineering teams choosing underlying inference providers alongside n8n, benchmark DeepSeek vs OpenAI business API economics.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is self-hosted n8n completely free for commercial companies?

n8n uses a Sustainable Use License (fair-code): self-hosting for internal business workflows is free, while embedding/white-labeling n8n inside a SaaS product sold to external users requires a commercial enterprise license.

Can Zapier handle AI agents without code?

Yes—Zapier Agents and AI Steps offer the fastest zero-code setup for non-technical staff, though high-frequency loops require monitoring task quotas closely.
